payload.title: System colours only, and richer social cards
payload.description: Author's direction 2026-09-23: (1) remove the light/dark toggle; the site follows the system colour scheme only (prefers-color-scheme), with no stored override. (2) Social cards always render in light mode. (3) Engine cards show the engine's spider chart (severity colours and shape per BD-d5d1a0), not a single big number. (4) Leaderboard-style cards (home, dimension, group, question) show the ranking as a horizontal bar chart of engines, most biased at the top, with the floor marked, rather than one big number. Cell cards may keep a big number with its interval. All cards keep the phone-feed legibility rules in docs/social-cards.md.
